notes.title: v1.03 Important Update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Animal AI perception components have been improved, they are no longer clumsy and slow to respond, they are more flexible and more sensitive, which increases the danger of some aggressive AI and increases the difficulty of the game
[*] Fix the problem that the resolution UI of some screens is not displayed completely, and some UI layouts are adjusted
[*] Increased the lethality and durability of bows, light crossbows, heavy crossbows, and other firearms
[*] The grenade launcher can be repaired. Increased  the explosion damage value. To repair the weapons or tools, you need to make a repair kit and drag it to the weapon to repair it. 
[*] Increased the capacity of most building inventories
[*] Increase backpack capacity, Reduced the amount of cloth used to craft it
[*] Increased the zoom speed and maximum display area of ​​the map, W, A, S, D control the moving map, and the mouse wheel controls the zoom map
[*] Animal AI optimization to improve fps
[*] Add lens water drop effect when it rains
[*] Added the recuperation function in the water of the cave, you can restore health and other status values ​​just by standing in the blue water without worrying about death.
[*] Some character animation improvements and LOD optimizations
[*] Reduced oxygen consumption while diving
[*] Increased the selling price of some weapon items
[*] Temporarily turn off the IK function,Leg bends due to IK
[*] Increased experience for hunting rhinos
[*] Adjust the color contrast display and size of animal health bar and HP value
[*] Now crafting workbench requires some iron ingots
[*] Improved mouse sensitivity
[*] Rotten coconut skin texture improved
[*] Fixed the problem that stone distance culling disappears
[*] Map landscape optimization and improvement
[*] Temporarily used calm ocean to improve FPS
[*] Temporarily turn off ray tracing in order to increase the fps, and the fps will be improved in the next step
[*] mine instance optimization
[*] Improve sky lighting
[*] Motion blur turned off
[*] Improved Komodo dragon damage animation
[*]Added the effect of the character's wet skin after entering the water
[/list]

notes.title: v1.02 Important Fix Update
notes.notes:
Hi, this update has fixed some bugs to make this version more stable, please remember to update the game, manually save the archive after entering the game, and reload the save file again, this will clear a lot of animal AI saved before, which will help improve fps , please give more feedback, the game will continue to update more interesting new content. Best Regards
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue of fps drop caused by repeated saving and loading of animal AI for a large number of spawns
[*] Fixed  where trees and collectible plants could not be cut down due to repeated saving and loading.
[*] Added atmosphere music to the menu interface
[*] Reduced the sensitivity of the mouse. If your mouse has a shift button, you can adjust the sensitivity by yourself. The function of setting the mouse sensitivity will be added in the future.
[*] Plants and rocks  LOD optimization
[*] Improved some small object model collision，prevent simulated physics from falling into the ground
[*] Fixed some unconventional resolution UI display issue 
[*] Fixed too high specular on character skin sweat trace
[*] Reduced the size of the Green Sea Turtle
[*] In order to optimize, set the resources dropped by mining and the materials on the ground can only exist for half an hour, so please try to pick up the resources to prevent them from disappearing, store the materials in the storage box, and keep the hunted animal body for 20 minutes, please cut the prey as soon as possible.
[/list]
